validation_evidence: The heavy soak command is: python3 tests/paired_runner_m2_heavy_soak.py --level heavy --report implementation/M2_OUTPUT_SOAK_REPORT.json. It produced 1048576 lines and 1073741824 combined stdout/stderr bytes in 876 ms with 19075072 bytes of controller RSS growth against a 67108864-byte threshold.

The massive-output half of the requirement is physically met. The long-duration half is bounded by the Milestone 1 60000 ms per-command timeout cap and belongs to the Milestone 3 multi-session work, so the record is not raised to VERIFIED_INTEGRATION.
